set.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- mvpa4s core, predictive and generic locus/image adapters compile and test independently with no ScalaFIM dependency.
- Fit, dataset, group and artifact integrations remain thin ScalaFIM consumers of the extracted revision.
- Existing prediction/RSA, resampling, exposure, dense/operator, normalization and scoped-lifetime evidence is preserved; replaced core code is deleted. The surface adapter is completed separately in U6.

Close after its child implementation tasks and their evidence satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md.
set.title: U4 milestone: Extract standalone mvpa4s and migrate analysis callers
